title: Hero face falls outside the declared Söhne system
evidence: `.hero { font-family: "Lobster", cursive; }` while the governing DESIGN.md declares only `Söhne, system-ui, sans-serif` and states "Söhne is the one face"; drift confirmed against the written system. Fix: set the hero in the system face at a display weight and fluid size, `.hero { font-family: "Söhne", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.5rem + 3vw, 3.5rem); }`, or add a display face to DESIGN.md first if the owner wants one.

title: Bootstrap 5 default palette shipped unthemed
evidence: Navbar and `.btn-primary` at Bootstrap's `$primary` #0d6efd, hover at its shade steps #0b5ed7 / #0a58ca, table borders at `$gray-300` #dee2e6, focus ring #0b5ed7; no token layer, every value is the library's own. Fix: define brand tokens once in OKLCH (`--brand: oklch(0.52 0.14 45); --brand-hover: oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h); --rule: oklch(0.88 0.008 60);`) and point the navbar, button, hover, table borders and the existing focus-visible ring at them.

title: Primary action blue sits inside the AI purple window
evidence: `.btn-primary { background: #0d6efd; }` computes to about oklch(0.58 0.23 260): hue 260 at chroma 0.23, inside the 255-325 / >= 0.15 window and on the same hue as Tailwind blue-500 (259.8), used as the primary fill. Fix: the C3 table's copper at a lightness that keeps the white label above 4.5:1, `background: oklch(0.52 0.14 45)` (about 145 degrees away), hover `oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h)`; or deep-cyan `oklch(0.5 0.1 205)`.

title: Cream ground, Instrument Serif and sage accent together
evidence: body `background: #faf8f5` (named cream hex), `font-family: 'Instrument Serif'` on the h1, `.accent` and `.btn` at `#15573a` (named sage), Inter on the lede, and an empty 4:3 `.shot` card to the right of the headline: all three legs plus the screenshot-card hero. Fix: anchor to a real brand or reference rather than the next tasteful palette: a cool off-white ground `oklch(0.98 0.004 250)`, a sans display with tuned weight and tracking (Poppins 600 at -0.02em), a hue taken from the grove subject, and a real photograph of a bed or seedling tray in place of the empty `.shot`; if warm-editorial is a stated decision, mark it `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: Emoji circles used as deploy status dots
evidence: `🟢` / `🟡` / `🔴` before Healthy, Degraded and Failed in the State column (lines 37-39): emoji as interface chrome, rendered differently on every OS. Fix: a drawn status mark from the page's own system, an 8px square or an inline SVG glyph per state coloured from tuned tokens (`--ok: oklch(0.52 0.12 145)`, `--warn: oklch(0.68 0.14 75)`, `--bad: oklch(0.55 0.18 25)`), keeping the text label so state is carried by shape, colour and word.

title: Emoji check marks used as list bullets
evidence: `✅` twice and `⚠️` as the bullets of `ul.checks` (lines 43-45). Fix: a marker drawn in the same SVG family as the status marks (`li::before` with a check or alert glyph at 1em in `--moss` and the warn token), or a two-column list of check and result.

title: Rocket emoji decorating the redeploy button
evidence: ``. Fix: let the verb carry the action; if the button wants an icon, use a circular-arrow redeploy glyph from the same SVG set as the status marks, at 1em in the button's text colour.

title: No viewport meta, so phones render a desktop canvas
evidence: The head carries only `<meta charset="utf-8">` and `<title>`; with no `<meta name="viewport">` mobile browsers lay the page out at about 980px and shrink it. Fix: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`, without `user-scalable=no`.

title: Shell and lede pinned to fixed pixel widths
evidence: `.shell { width: 1200px; padding: 64px 40px; }` and `.lede { width: 640px; }` (line 17): every viewport under 1280px scrolls sideways. Fix: `.shell { width: min(100% - 2rem, 75rem); padding: clamp(2rem, 1rem + 4vw, 4rem) clamp(1rem, 0.5rem + 2vw, 2.5rem); }` and `.lede { max-width: 60ch; }`.

title: Lane grid asserts three 360px columns
evidence: `.lanes { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 360px); gap: 40px; }` = 1160px of columns at every width. Fix: `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 18rem), 1fr)); gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);`.

title: Middle-dot meta strings repeated on every lane
evidence:
`1,382 mi · $2.41/mi · 62 loads posted` on all three lanes (lines 32, 36, 40): three A · B · C strings, six spaced middle dots. Fix: a small definition list per lane (`
Distance
1,382 mi
Spot rate
$2.41/mi
Loads posted
62
`) laid out in a row with `gap`, which keeps the signal colour on the rate and labels each figure.

title: Flat-terminal system: near-black, 8% hairlines, grey accent
evidence: Code-only reading of the token map: ground oklch(0.12 0.003 270) vs panel oklch(0.13 0.003 270), a tint step of about 1.01:1, so one perceivable surface level, not three (S3); the only edge is `--hair: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.08)`, about 1.2:1 against the panel (S4); `--accent: oklch(0.6 0.02 270)` at chroma 0.02, used only as the current nav item's text colour (S1, S2); colour otherwise reserved for --ok / --bad status; system-ui at weight 400 with 600 headings. S3 and S4 fail together with S1 and S2 on a dark ground. Fix (pairing table, no further removal): a three-level ladder `--ground: oklch(0.15 0.012 250)`, `--panel: oklch(0.2 0.014 250)`, `--overlay: oklch(0.25 0.016 250)` with a top-edge rim `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.07)` and a border that measures at least 1.3:1 against the panel; a real accent `oklch(0.7 0.14 205)` as the current-nav underline fill, the focus ring and the key figure; a weight ladder of 400 body, 550 labels, 650 figures.

title: Focus ring keyed to :focus, not :focus-visible
evidence: Both buttons (lines 31 and 34) carry `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-600 focus:ring-offset-2` with no `focus-visible:` variant, so a mouse click draws the same ring as keyboard focus. Fix: keep the ring and scope it to keyboard focus, `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-teal-600 focus-visible:ring-offset-2`.

title: Frosted sticky nav, the verbatim backdrop-blur signature
evidence: `<nav class="backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border-b sticky top-0">`. Fix: a solid nav on a raised surface with a brand tint, `background: oklch(0.97 0.01 60); border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.01 60);`, static unless the page is long enough to need it, or a sidebar.

title: Neon purple glow on the call-to-action
evidence: `.cta { box-shadow: 0 0 40px 6px rgba(168,85,247,.6); }`: a 40px-spread halo in purple-500 (#a855f7, hue 304, also inside the C3 window) with no dark-mode need. Fix: a rim plus a tuned drop, `box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.25), 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.02 45 / 0.25);`, on a committed brand fill outside the purple arc such as `oklch(0.52 0.14 45)`.

title: Focus outline removed with no focus-visible replacement
evidence: `a:focus, button:focus { outline: none; }` and no `:focus-visible` rule anywhere, so the firing-schedule button shows no keyboard focus. Fix: `button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.14 45); outline-offset: 2px; }` and drop the blanket rule, or narrow it to `:focus:not(:focus-visible)`.

title: Gradient text on the hero headline
evidence: `bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 via-fuchsia-500 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent` on the h1; every stop sits in the C3 purple window (aliases C3, C5). Fix: a solid ink headline whose emphasis comes from size, weight and tracking, `font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.4rem + 3.5vw, 3.75rem); font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 250);`, with colour moved to one committed brand fill on the primary action, and a headline that says what the product does (the subtext already does: "Track every invoice across every client").

title: Neutral grey text on a saturated blue block
evidence: `<div class="bg-blue-800 text-gray-300 p-4">`: gray-300 (chroma about 0.01) at rest on blue-800 in one class set. Fix: tint the text from the surface hue, `text-blue-100` or `color: oklch(0.92 0.04 265)`, which also keeps it above 4.5:1.

title: Promo banner sets grey text on blue
evidence: `.promo { background: #1e40af; color: #d1d5db; }`: gray-300 on blue-800, the CSS form of the same untuned neutral. Fix: `color: oklch(0.92 0.04 265);` so the secondary text carries the surface's hue.

title: Verbatim Tailwind hero triplet on the h1
evidence: `class="text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight"`: the exact unmodified run, in order (alias T14). Fix: a fluid ramp with tuned tracking, never a fixed size: `font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 1.2rem + 4.4vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-weight: 650;`, or a `--step-4` custom property beside the page's existing tokens.

title: Camera product page with no image of the camera
evidence: Counts: 0 img / picture / figure / video across 4 sections on a page selling a physical rangefinder; 12 of 12 entity rows carry only a 22px stroke SVG and text. Fix: show the object, at least one real image per two sections: a product shot of the brass top plate in the header (``), a shutter or cutaway photograph in Inside the body, a mount close-up in Glass and mount; keep the brass stroke icons on the rows.

title: Icon-only remove button has no accessible name
evidence: `<button class="remove" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" ...>` with no `aria-label`, hidden text or `<title>`; a screen reader announces only "button". Fix: `<button class="remove" type="button" aria-label="Delete draft: Re: bench slot for the tenor sax"><svg aria-hidden="true" ...>`.

title: Cream ground with Instrument Serif display
evidence: `body { background: #faf8f5; font-family: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; }` with Inter on the subtitle: the named cream hex plus a listed serif display, two legs of the combination. Fix: anchor colour and type to the planning product's real brand: a cool off-white `oklch(0.98 0.004 250)`, a sans display with tuned weight and tracking, an accent chosen for the product; or record the decision with `anti-slop-allow: <reason>`.

title: Hero headline is vague transformation copy
evidence:
`

Transform your workflow. Effortlessly.

`: no object and no claim a reader can check, while the subtitle under it already says what the product does. Fix: promote the specific line to the headline, "Plan the week with your whole team in one place", and use the subtitle slot for a concrete detail of how.

title: unDraw stock illustration as the hero graphic
evidence: ``. Fix: a real screenshot of the weekly planning view, or illustration commissioned in the brand palette, with alt text that says what it shows.

title: App shell fixed at 1180px with four 260px columns
evidence: `.app-shell { width: 1180px; height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 260px); }`: a fixed width, an asserted column count and a 100vh height (alias P3) in one rule. Fix: `width: min(100% - 2rem, 74rem); min-height: 100dvh; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));`.

title: Pulsing dot beside the Live label
evidence: `.live-dot` (8px, `border-radius: 50%`) runs `animation: pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite` (opacity 1 to .4, scale 1 to .85) next to the word "Live" (line 27). Fix: content-borne liveness, a timestamp that updates ("Updated 12 s ago") or the queue count changing in place; a static dot may stay as a state mark.

title: animate-ping dot beside the queue count
evidence: `<span class="absolute inline-flex h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 animate-ping">` after "Four people are waiting.". Fix: let the number carry the liveness, updating the count inside an `aria-live="polite"` region, with no ping.

title: Fuchsia blur blob behind the hero
evidence: `<div class="absolute -z-10 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-300 blur-3xl opacity-20">`: the verbatim blur-blob class run. Fix: a solid brand block behind the hero or a real screenshot of the sync view; grain under 0.05 if atmosphere is wanted.

title: Welcome back! greeting on a marketing hero
evidence:
`

Welcome back! Pick up where the last sync left off.

` on a page whose action goes to /signup. Fix: show what only this product knows, "Your last sync finished 3 hours ago" for a signed-in visitor, or the product's concrete claim for a new one.

title: Indigo-to-violet gradient on the primary CTA
evidence: `bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-violet-600` on the tour link: hues about 277 and 293 at chroma about 0.2, both in the 255-325 window. Fix: one committed brand fill outside the arc, `background: oklch(0.52 0.14 45)` (burnt copper) or `oklch(0.5 0.14 235)` (deep prussian), hover derived with `oklch(from var(--brand) calc(l - 0.05) c h)`.

title: shadcn demo revenue figure $45,231.89
evidence:
`

$45,231.89

` with `+20.1% from last month` (line 24): the shadcn dashboard demo value verbatim. Fix: the product's real metric with real comparison context (records synced this week against last week), or in its place a screenshot of the product's own sync view.

title: Logo wall scrolls forever with no pause control
evidence: `.track { animation: scroll 30s linear infinite; }` translating -50% of a duplicated logo row, no pause control and no hover or focus pause; the no-preference gate protects only readers who asked for less motion (WCAG 2.2.2; alias L8). Fix: a static wrapping strip, `.track { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3rem; }` with logos at about 40% opacity and full colour on hover; if motion must stay, a visible pause button plus `.track:hover, .track:focus-within { animation-play-state: paused; }`.

title: Refresh button wired to an empty handler
evidence: `<button onclick="/* TODO: wire refresh */">Refresh</button>`: the control does nothing. Fix: wire it to refetch invoices with a busy state (`aria-busy="true"` and the text "Refreshing invoices...") and an inline error with retry; until it works, show a "Last updated 09:41" timestamp in its place.

title: Invoice table ships the populated state only
evidence: Three hard-coded rows, all "Paid"; no empty, loading, error, overdue or unpaid state anywhere on the surface. Fix: an empty state with voice and an action ("No invoices yet" plus "Create the first invoice"), a loading row with text, an error row with retry, and Due / Overdue statuses carried by text as well as colour.

title: JetBrains Mono on talent readouts and counters
evidence: `font-family: var(--font-mono)` ("JetBrains Mono") on talent-level-value, talent-level-preset, talent-tree-points, talent-points-spent, talent-node-rank and `talent-table td.num` (lines 7-18), every one of which already sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Fix: `font-family: var(--font-sans)` on those six selectors, keeping tabular-nums for alignment and the existing weight 600 and primary text colour for emphasis; mono may stay on the export textarea and readonly field only if they hold a pasteable build string.

title: Order confirmation bounces twice on entry
evidence: `.toast { animation: bounce-in 600ms both; }` with keyframes 0 / -24px / 0 / -10px / 0 (two reversals) on the order-placed status message. Fix: a settle that answers the action, `@keyframes settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.5rem); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }` at 220ms ease-out, inside the existing no-preference gate.

title: Back-easing curve anticipates and overshoots on the menu
evidence: `.menu { transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55); }`: y1 -0.55 anticipates and y2 1.55 overshoots. Fix: `transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);`, or the single-overshoot spring `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` if the menu should feel springy.

title: animate-bounce arrow under the confirmation
evidence: `<svg class="cue animate-bounce" aria-hidden="true">` down-arrow below the order message. Fix: a static arrow, or better a text link to the orders page ("Track this order") that carries the next step.

title: Three unheaded paragraphs between the tiles and table
evidence:
Measurement: 3 orphan paragraphs (lines 34-36) whose parent is `main`, with a card list and a table as siblings and no heading; the longest (line 35) is 63 words. Fix: move them into a headed section below the table ("About these figures") beside the existing explanatory sections, and turn the hourly-refresh sentence into the tiles' caption (`

Refreshed hourly from the ledger service

`).

title: Hairline graph-paper grid behind the whole page
evidence: `body::before` paints two 1px `linear-gradient`s at right angles on a `24px 24px` tile, fixed over the viewport. Fix: a solid ground, with a tone shift between sections if separation is needed.

title: Dot field behind the hero
evidence: `.hero { background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(0.85 0 0) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 16px 16px; }`. Fix: a solid brand-tinted block, or a screenshot of the first release as the hero's focal visual.

title: Repeating diagonal stripes behind the promo
evidence: `.promo { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, oklch(0.95 0.02 80) 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px); }`. Fix: a single tone fill, `background: oklch(0.95 0.02 80);`, which keeps the band's separation without the pattern.

title: Gradient text on one hero word
evidence: `.accent { background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.62 0.15 25), oklch(0.72 0.16 60)); background-clip: text; color: transparent; }` on "reconciled" in the h1 (line 28), with no `anti-slop-allow` line. Fix: let the whole line carry the emphasis (it is already tuned at 3rem / 500 / -0.02em) in solid ink; if the gradient is the identity guide's wordmark treatment, mark it `anti-slop-allow: <guide reference>`.

title: Serif display paired with a warm-clay accent
evidence: `font-family: 'GT Sectra', Charter, Georgia, serif` on body and h1, with `a.cta { color: oklch(0.55 0.15 25) }` and the gradient's oklch(0.62 0.15 25) stop: hue 25 at chroma 0.15, the warm-clay variant, beside a serif display. The paper oklch(0.98 0.004 90) is under the cream chroma, so two legs, not three. Fix: record the editorial decision (`anti-slop-allow: <brand reason>`) or move one leg: keep GT Sectra with an accent from the ledger's own world, `oklch(0.5 0.14 235)` deep prussian, or keep terracotta and set the display in the brand sans.

title: Four paragraphs of methodology sit above the data table
evidence: Primary element taken: the Drop sources table (first `table` in main, line 47). Running prose above it on first paint: the 28-word lede plus four paragraphs of about 75, 63, 60 and 55 words, roughly 280 words against the 40-word reference-page budget. Fix: keep the identity block (image, h1, lede, facts) on top, put the drop table directly under it, and move "About the Thornfang Blade" below the table, with the log-filtering paragraph behind `<details><summary>How these figures are calculated</summary>`.

title: Saturated cyan halo fading behind the hero
evidence: `.hero { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.8), transparent 70%); }`: cyan-400 at 0.8 alpha fading to transparent on a #0b0b10 ground. Fix: a light source felt rather than seen, `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, oklch(0.75 0.1 210 / 0.05), transparent 70%)`, over a committed brand field, with the rota itself as the focal visual.

title: Hero letters tracked at -0.1em collide
evidence: `.hero h1 { font-size: 32px; letter-spacing: -0.1em; }`: tighter than the -0.07em floor that applies below 40px. Fix: `letter-spacing: -0.02em;`, the T8 ladder value for this size.

title: Article body leading at 1.15
evidence: `.article p { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.15; }` on a 50-word paragraph; running text under 1.3. Fix: `line-height: 1.5;`.

title: Mixed-case note text tracked at 0.12em
evidence: `.note p { letter-spacing: 0.12em; }` on a full mixed-case sentence, wider than the 0.05em running-text limit. Fix: `letter-spacing: 0;` (open tracking only on short capitalised labels).

title: Justified 22ch sidebar with no hyphenation
evidence: `.sidebar-note { width: 22ch; text-align: justify; }` with no `hyphens: auto`: a column under about 45 characters that will river. Fix: `text-align: start;` (ragged right), or keep justify with `hyphens: auto;` under the page's `lang="en"` and widen to `max-width: 32ch`.

title: Unmodified shadcn Card class run
evidence: `<div class="rounded-lg border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the shadcn Card default verbatim (pre-v4 radius). Fix: the same frame with tuned tokens: the product's radius (`rounded-[3px]`), a border colour that measures against both surfaces (`border-[oklch(0.86_0.01_60)]`), shadow only as one step of a three-level elevation scale, padding from the spacing scale, and a seat meter in the brand accent as the card's focal element.

title: shadcn init token values shipped untouched
evidence: `--radius: 0.625rem; --background: oklch(1 0 0); --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0); --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0); --border / --input: oklch(0.922 0 0); --ring: oklch(0.708 0 0)` (lines 9-19): the current-generation init values verbatim; OKLCH notation, no tuned value. Fix: `--primary: oklch(0.52 0.14 45)` (or a hue from the product), `--background: oklch(0.985 0.004 250)`, a tuned ink `--foreground: oklch(0.22 0.014 250)`, a radius identity (`--radius: 3px`), and `--border` tuned to measure against both surfaces; derive hover and ring with relative colour syntax.

title: Seat usage card is the default shadcn Card
evidence: `<div class="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6">`: the current shadcn Card class run verbatim, a separate span from the token block. Fix: recompose with the tuned tokens: a framed panel on a measured tint step with the committed radius, and a 42-of-100 seat meter bar in the brand accent as its focal element.

title: Teal left border on the tip callout
evidence: `.tip { border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid oklch(0.52 0.1 180); }` on a rounded card. Fix: keep the tinted background and give the callout a heading device instead, a `<strong>` "Tip" label in the accent, or a leaf icon from the page's set.

title: Inline-start bar on the blockquote
evidence: `.quote { border-inline-start: 3px solid oklch(0.5 0.12 160); }` on a square box. Fix: set the quote in a larger size with a hanging quotation mark in the accent, or a neutral 1px rule if a rule is wanted.

title: Pseudo-element side bar on the feature card
evidence: `.feature::before { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 4px; background: oklch(0.6 0.15 60); }` on a rounded card. Fix: carry the accent in an icon or a heading on the card ("Seed trays" set in the accent), and keep the #f8fafc fill as the container.

title: Inset side shadow faking a left stripe
evidence: `.panel { border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 oklch(0.5 0.13 240); }` on the frost note. Fix: if it is a warning, make it one: `role="alert"` with an alert icon and a "Frost warning" label, where a severity edge is substance; otherwise drop the stripe in favour of the label.

title: border-l-4 teal stripe on a rounded card
evidence:
`
Compost turned on Monday.
`. Fix: a date label as the heading device (`` set in the accent above the note), or a tone shift between notes instead of a stripe on each.

title: Heading jumps from h2 to h4
evidence:
`

Sending an item back

` is followed by `

Refund timing

`, sized up with `h4 { font-size: 1.25rem; }`. Fix: `

Refund timing

` and style h3 to the size wanted.

title: Page view transition runs 650ms
evidence: `::view-transition-old(root), ::view-transition-new(root) { animation-duration: 650ms; }` on every navigation, over the 400ms page-change ceiling. Fix: `animation-duration: 240ms;`, keeping the no-preference gate.

title: Save button bypasses spacing, radius and brand tokens
evidence: `.save { background: oklch(0.543 0.104 159); padding: 11px 17px; border-radius: 5px; }` (lines 24-27) beside defined `--brand: oklch(0.49 0.085 158)`, `--space-300: 12px` and `--radius: 6px`; hover adds a third green, oklch(0.5 0.11 160). title: Hint margin and colour off the token system
evidence: `.hint { color: oklch(0.554 0.006 107); margin-top: 9px; font-size: 13px; }`: 9px sits between the defined `--space-200: 8px` and `--space-300: 12px`, and the grey is a raw value. title: Article body set at 11px
evidence: `.article p { font-size: 11px; }` on a 45-word renewal paragraph: running text under the 12px floor (16px recommended). Fix: `font-size: 1rem;`, inheriting the body size.

title: Inline price note at 10px
evidence: `.price-note { font-size: 0.625rem; }` (10px) on "Taxes added at checkout." inside a running paragraph, not legal small print. Fix: `font-size: 0.875rem;` with de-emphasis from a dim colour token rather than size.

title: Footer nav links at 10px
evidence: `.footer-nav a { font-size: 10px; }`: functional link text under the 11px floor. Fix: `font-size: 0.875rem;` with `padding-block: 0.25rem` so each link also clears a 24px target.

title: One 8px radius on every control
evidence: `border-radius: 8px` on input / select / textarea (line 21), `.chip` (line 25) and `button.submit` (line 27): five control types share the shadcn-era default. Fix: commit to a radius identity and vary it by role, e.g. `--r-field: 2px; --r-chip: 999px; --r-action: 2px;` for a workbench intake form.

title: rounded-full applied to every control, textarea included
evidence: `rounded-full` on the input (line 28), select (33), textarea (41), chip (45) and submit button (48); the three-row textarea gets a pill radius that clips its corners. Fix: radius by role: fields and the submit at `rounded-[2px]` to match the 2px actions elsewhere in Ledger, `rounded-full` kept only on the "runs at 04:00" chip.

title: App column sized with 100vh
evidence: `.app { height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }`: on mobile 100vh resolves against the largest viewport, so the bottom of the column sits under the browser toolbar. Fix: `height: 100dvh;`.

title: Fixed action bar ignores the safe-area inset
evidence: `.bar { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; }` with no `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` and no `viewport-fit=cover`; `.scroll` has no bottom padding, so the last stop also sits behind the bar. Fix: `.bar { padding-bottom: max(0.75rem, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }`, `viewport-fit=cover` in the viewport meta, and `.scroll { padding-bottom: calc(4.5rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }`.

title: Firing card layout keyed to viewport, not column
evidence: `@media (min-width: 60rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; } }` restyles a component that renders in both the 14-18rem rail and the main column, so at 60rem the rail's copy gets a 9rem label column inside an 18rem box. Fix: `.rail, .main { container-type: inline-size; } @container (min-width: 28rem) { .firing { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9rem 1fr; column-gap: 1.5rem; } }`.

title: Viewport meta disables pinch zoom
evidence: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no">`. Fix: `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`.

title: Positive tabindex reorders the search form
evidence: `tabindex="3"` on the search field, `1` and `2` on the date fields, `4` on Search (lines 18-26): Tab lands on Issued after first, skipping the field the page leads with. Fix: remove all four tabindex attributes and order the DOM in the intended sequence.

title: White label on the honey button fails contrast
evidence: `.btn { background: oklch(0.68 0.14 75); color: #ffffff; font-size: 16px; }` computes to about 2.95:1 against a 4.5:1 bar; the hover `oklch(0.74 0.12 75)` is lower still, about 2.4:1. Fix: keep the hue and move lightness, `background: oklch(0.48 0.12 75)` (about 6.6:1 with white) and hover `oklch(0.42 0.12 75)`.

title: Tag text just under AA on its chip
evidence: `.tag { background: #f1f5f9; color: #6b7280; }` = 4.41:1 against a 4.5:1 bar (within 0.3, so LOW). Fix: `color: #475569;` (about 7.0:1).

title: Card meta text fails contrast on navy
evidence: `.card .meta { color: #64748b; }` on `.card { background: #0f172a; }` = 3.75:1 against a 4.5:1 bar. Fix: `color: #94a3b8;` (about 7.0:1).

title: Shipped-date note fails contrast on white
evidence: `.note { color: #8a8a8a; font-size: 14px; }` on the #ffffff body = 3.45:1 against a 4.5:1 bar. Fix: `color: #6b6b6b;` (about 5.3:1), which keeps it secondary to the #1f2937 body text.
